props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial value when the form's `defaultValues` doesn't supply one.
Form-level `defaultValues` takes precedence.

props.name: name
props.description: Field name — must be unique within the form.

props.name: validators
props.description:
Synchronous validators. Each returns `null` (or `undefined`) for valid,
or a non-empty string describing the error. Stops at the first error.

slots.name: default
slots.type: { value: unknown; error: string | null; setValue: (value: unknown) => void; disabled: boolean; }
